Luden's Echo

2750 goldFinished item

A mage item with a lot of ability power and mana whose damaging abilities fire extra bolts that hit your target and enemies near them.

Stats

  • 100 Ability Power
  • 600 Mana
  • 10 Ability Haste

What it does

Echo: Damaging Abilities fire 6 Echoes that deal bonus magic damage to the target and nearby enemies. Remaining Echoes fire on the primary target, dealing 20% damage.

When to buy it

Buy it as a first item on burst and poke mages who want strong early damage.

Good on

Lux Syndra Orianna Xerath Ziggs LeBlanc

Builds from
